messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 3):
"""
8 Financial limits of coverage i. Sub-limit (It is a predefined limit and the insurance company will not pay any amount in excess of this limit) ii. Co-payment (It is a specified amount/percentage of the admissible claim amount to be paid by policyholder/insured). iii. Deductible (It is a specified amount: - up to which an insurance company will not pay any claim, and - which will be deducted from total claim amount (if claim amount is more than the specified amount) iv. Any other limit (as applicable) The policy will pay only up to the limits specified hereunder for the following diseases/procedures: XX XX In case of a claim, this policy requires you to share the following costs:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What are the different types of financial limits that can be applied to a health insurance claim?","answer":"The policy can apply sub-limits, co-payment, deductible, and any other applicable limits.","facts":["Sub-limit (It is a predefined limit and the insurance company will not pay any amount in excess of this limit)","Co-payment (It is a specified amount/percentage of the admissible claim amount to be paid by policyholder/insured)","Deductible (It is a specified amount: - up to which an insurance company will not pay any claim, and - which will be deducted from total claim amount (if claim amount is more than the specified amount))","Any other limit (as applicable)"]},{"question":"What does the policy state about the insurer’s payment when a claim exceeds a predefined sub-limit?","answer":"The insurer will not pay any amount in excess of the sub-limit.","facts":["Sub-limit (It is a predefined limit and the insurance company will not pay any amount in excess of this limit)"]}]}
